dialogue.text: The doors went wide against the wind
dialogue.zh: 門在風中大開
dialogue.ja: 風に逆らって扉が大きく開いた
dialogue.local: The doors went wide against the wind
dialogue.en: The doors went wide against the wind

dialogue.text: the snow came drifting in
dialogue.zh: 雪飄進來
dialogue.ja: 雪が漂いながら入ってきた
dialogue.local: the snow came drifting in
dialogue.en: the snow came drifting in

dialogue.text: I knew your step, I knew your coat, I felt it on my skin
dialogue.zh: 我認得你的腳步，認得你的外套，感覺到它貼著我的皮膚
dialogue.ja: あなたの歩みも、コートも知っていて、肌で感じた
dialogue.local: I knew your step, I knew your coat, I felt it on my skin
dialogue.en: I knew your step, I knew your coat, I felt it on my skin

dialogue.text: The fire was low, the room was still, I stood where I would stand
dialogue.zh: 火光微弱，房間寂靜，我站在我該站的地方
dialogue.ja: 火は弱く、部屋は静かで、私は立つべき場所に立っていた
dialogue.local: The fire was low, the room was still, I stood where I would stand
dialogue.en: The fire was low, the room was still, I stood where I would stand

dialogue.text: You crossed the floor, you spoke my name, but not the way you can
dialogue.zh: 你走過地板，叫了我的名字，但不是你平常的方式
dialogue.ja: あなたは床を横切り、私の名前を呼んだが、いつもの呼び方ではなかった
dialogue.local: You crossed the floor, you spoke my name, but not the way you can
dialogue.en: You crossed the floor, you spoke my name, but not the way you can

dialogue.text: You hold my hand, it feels too light
dialogue.zh: 你握著我的手，感覺太輕了
dialogue.ja: あなたは私の手を握ったが、とても軽く感じた
dialogue.local: You hold my hand, it feels too light
dialogue.en: You hold my hand, it feels too light

dialogue.text: You came back, but not to me
dialogue.zh: 你回來了，但不是回到我這裡
dialogue.ja: あなたは戻ってきたけど、私のところには戻ってこなかった
dialogue.local: You came back, but not to me
dialogue.en: You came back, but not to me

dialogue.text: You came back, I barely see all the things you used to be
dialogue.zh: 你回來了，我幾乎看不見你曾經的模樣
dialogue.ja: あなたは戻ってきたけど、かつてのあなたの姿はほとんど見えない
dialogue.local: You came back, I barely see all the things you used to be
dialogue.en: You came back, I barely see all the things you used to be

dialogue.text: You're here, not with me
dialogue.zh: 你在這裡，但不在我身邊
dialogue.ja: あなたはここにいるけど、私と一緒ではない
dialogue.local: You're here, not with me
dialogue.en: You're here, not with me

dialogue.text: You came back, but not the same
dialogue.zh: 你回來了，但已經不同了
dialogue.ja: あなたは戻ってきたけど、同じではない
dialogue.local: You came back, but not the same
dialogue.en: You came back, but not the same

dialogue.text: You came back without the blame, I don't even say your name
dialogue.zh: 你回來了，沒有責備，我甚至不說你的名字
dialogue.ja: あなたは責めることなく戻ってきた、私は名前さえ呼ばない
dialogue.local: You came back without the blame, I don't even say your name
dialogue.en: You came back without the blame, I don't even say your name

dialogue.text: You're here, not the same
dialogue.zh: 你在這裡，但已經不同
dialogue.ja: あなたはここにいるけど、同じではない
dialogue.local: You're here, not the same
dialogue.en: You're here, not the same

dialogue.text: We sit beside the same old board, the cuffs, the quiet air
dialogue.zh: 我們坐在同一張舊桌旁，手銬，寂靜的空氣
dialogue.ja: 私たちは同じ古いテーブルのそばに座り、手錠と静かな空気があった
dialogue.local: We sit beside the same old board, the cuffs, the quiet air
dialogue.en: We sit beside the same old board, the cuffs, the quiet air

dialogue.text: You look at me like someone known, but not like someone dead
dialogue.zh: 你看著我，像認識的人，但不像死去的人
dialogue.ja: あなたは私を知っている人のように見つめるが、死んだ人のようではない
dialogue.local: You look at me like someone known, but not like someone dead
dialogue.en: You look at me like someone known, but not like someone dead

dialogue.text: Your voice is calm, your eyes are full like winter on a lake
dialogue.zh: 你的聲音平靜，眼神像冬天的湖面一樣深沉
dialogue.ja: あなたの声は穏やかで、目は湖の冬のように満ちている
dialogue.local: Your voice is calm, your eyes are full like winter on a lake
dialogue.en: Your voice is calm, your eyes are full like winter on a lake

dialogue.text: I reach for what we used to have, but something doesn't wait
dialogue.zh: 我伸手想抓住我們曾擁有的，但有些東西不再等待
dialogue.ja: 私はかつて持っていたものに手を伸ばすが、何かが待っていない
dialogue.local: I reach for what we used to have, but something doesn't wait
dialogue.en: I reach for what we used to have, but something doesn't wait

dialogue.text: I hear your breath, I don't feel you
dialogue.zh: 我聽見你的呼吸，卻感覺不到你
dialogue.ja: あなたの息遣いは聞こえるが、感じられない
dialogue.local: I hear your breath, I don't feel you
dialogue.en: I hear your breath, I don't feel you

dialogue.text: You came back, but not to me
dialogue.zh: 你回來了，但不是回到我這裡
dialogue.ja: あなたは戻ってきたけど、私のところには戻ってこなかった
dialogue.local: You came back, but not to me
dialogue.en: You came back, but not to me

dialogue.text: You came back, I barely see all the warmth you used to be
dialogue.zh: 你回來了，我幾乎看不見你曾經的溫暖
dialogue.ja: あなたは戻ってきたけど、かつての温かさはほとんど見えない
dialogue.local: You came back, I barely see all the warmth you used to be
dialogue.en: You came back, I barely see all the warmth you used to be

dialogue.zh: 你在這裡，但不在我身邊
dialogue.ja: あなたはここにいるけど、私と一緒ではない
dialogue.local: You're here, not with me
dialogue.en: You're here, not with me

dialogue.local: You came back, but not the same
dialogue.en: You came back, but not the same

dialogue.local: You came back without the blame, I don't even call your name
dialogue.en: You came back without the blame, I don't even call your name

dialogue.text: You're here, not the same
dialogue.zh: 你在這裡，但已經不同
dialogue.ja: あなたはここにいるけど、同じではない
dialogue.local: You're here, not the same
dialogue.en: You're here, not the same

dialogue.text: If I close my eyes tonight, I can feel you like before
dialogue.zh: 如果我今晚閉上眼睛，我能感覺到你像以前一樣
dialogue.ja: もし今夜目を閉じれば、以前のようにあなたを感じられる
dialogue.local: If I close my eyes tonight, I can feel you like before
dialogue.en: If I close my eyes tonight, I can feel you like before

dialogue.text: But the man who crossed that door is not the one I knew
dialogue.zh: 但穿過那扇門的人，不是我認識的那個
dialogue.ja: でもあの扉をくぐった男は、私が知っていた人ではない
dialogue.local: But the man who crossed that door is not the one I knew
dialogue.en: But the man who crossed that door is not the one I knew

dialogue.text: If I speak and say it plain, will you turn or walk away?
dialogue.zh: 如果我說出來，你會轉身還是離開？
dialogue.ja: はっきり言ったら、あなたは振り向く？それとも去る？
dialogue.local: If I speak and say it plain, will you turn or walk away?
dialogue.en: If I speak and say it plain, will you turn or walk away?

dialogue.text: Are you lost or just erased?
dialogue.zh: 你是迷失了還是被抹去了？
dialogue.ja: あなたは迷子？それとも消されてしまった？
dialogue.local: Are you lost or just erased?
dialogue.en: Are you lost or just erased?

dialogue.text: Standing here and you, you came back, but not to me
dialogue.zh: 站在這裡的你，你回來了，但不是回到我這裡
dialogue.ja: ここに立つあなたは戻ってきたけど、私のところには戻ってこなかった
dialogue.local: Standing here and you, you came back, but not to me
dialogue.en: Standing here and you, you came back, but not to me

dialogue.text: You came back, I cannot reach all the words between us bleed
dialogue.zh: 你回來了，我無法觸及我們之間流淌的所有話語
dialogue.ja: あなたは戻ってきたけど、私たちの間に流れる言葉には届かない
dialogue.local: You came back, I cannot reach all the words between us bleed
dialogue.en: You came back, I cannot reach all the words between us bleed

dialogue.text: You're here out of reach
dialogue.zh: 你在這裡，但觸不可及
dialogue.ja: あなたはここにいるけど、届かないところにいる
dialogue.local: You're here out of reach
dialogue.en: You're here out of reach

dialogue.text: You came back, but not the same
dialogue.zh: 你回來了，但已經不同了
dialogue.ja: あなたは戻ってきたけど、同じではない
dialogue.local: You came back, but not the same
dialogue.en: You came back, but not the same

dialogue.text: You came back, I lost the blame, I don't even feel the pain
dialogue.zh: 你回來了，我不再責怪，甚至感覺不到痛苦
dialogue.ja: あなたは戻ってきた、私は責めることをやめ、痛みさえ感じない
dialogue.local: You came back, I lost the blame, I don't even feel the pain
dialogue.en: You came back, I lost the blame, I don't even feel the pain

dialogue.text: You're here, but you've changed
dialogue.zh: 你在這裡，但你已經改變了
dialogue.ja: あなたはここにいるけど、変わってしまった
dialogue.local: You're here, but you've changed
dialogue.en: You're here, but you've changed

dialogue.zh: 火光微弱，房間寂靜
dialogue.ja: 火は弱く、部屋は静かだ
dialogue.local: The fire is low, the room is still
dialogue.en: The fire is low, the room is still

dialogue.text: You sit right here, I feel the chill
dialogue.zh: 你就坐在這裡，我感覺到寒意
dialogue.ja: あなたはここに座っていて、私は寒さを感じる
dialogue.local: You sit right here, I feel the chill
dialogue.en: You sit right here, I feel the chill
